hero.title: SetLux
hero.subtitle: Lighting department management.
hero.lead: All your technical workflow, organized in one place.

whatIs.title: What is SetLux?
whatIs.lead1: SetLux is a tool to organize and centralize the lighting department’s work, built from real on‑set experience.

benefits.label: BENEFITS
benefits.title: Why SetLux?
benefits.subtitle: Benefits shaped around the real work of gaffers and best boys, with stronger continuity between operations and financial follow-up.

homeItem.title: Less scattered info, more continuity
homeItem.description: Project, crew, calendar and financial follow-up connected in one flow.

saveTime.title: Less admin outside the shoot
saveTime.description: Reduce repetitive tasks and avoid duplicating information between project setup, calendar, reports and payroll.

reduceErrors.title: Fewer operational and financial errors
reduceErrors.description: Avoid misunderstandings around workdays, hours, extras and financial concepts thanks to more connected information.

documentation.title: Continuity from plan to execution
documentation.description: What you prepare in the calendar and crew setup feeds reports, payroll and timesheets without redoing the work.

transparency.title: Clearer financial visibility
transparency.description: Get a clearer view of workdays, extras and per-person financial follow-up inside the same project.

allInOne.title: One workflow for lighting
allInOne.description: From conditions and crew to reports, payroll and timesheets, everything stays connected in one tool.

legal.title: Built for how the crew actually works
legal.description: Designed around real lighting department operations, not around forcing generic spreadsheets to fit.

useCases.label: USE CASES
useCases.title: Use cases
useCases.subtitle: How SetLux adapts to different types of shoots in the lighting department.

fiction.title: Fiction
fiction.description: For projects with shooting continuity, week-based planning, evolving crew needs and detailed tracking of workdays and requirements.
features: Crew organization by phases and needs
Tracking of workdays and on-shoot changes
Continuity between calendar, reports, payroll and timesheets

ads.title: Advertising
ads.description: Designed for shoots with specific conditions, variable crews and advertising‑style schedules.
features: Managing reinforcements, special days and holidays

tv.title: TV
tv.description: For television productions with ongoing pace, frequent changes and the need to coordinate crew, planning and follow-up with speed.
features: Agile crew organization by day and week
Operational and financial control in the same workflow
Continuous project follow-up without losing context

features.label: FEATURES
features.title: Main features
features.subtitle: Tools designed for real lighting‑department work, from set to payroll.

labor.title: Shoot conditions
labor.description: Configure the economic and labor conditions of the shoot: workdays, overtime, per diems, night work, and holidays.

team.title: Team Management
team.description: Organize the lighting team by roles and work phases: base, extra, prelight and wrap.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.description: Plan shooting weeks, locations, team, and technical needs in a single operational calendar.

timesheet.title: Timesheet
timesheet.description: Weekly schedule record for each worker, automatically generated from the calendar.

reports.title: Reports
reports.description: Log the day‑to‑day of the shoot: overtime, turnarounds, night work, per diems, transport and any economic concept for the team.

payroll.title: Payroll
payroll.description: Automatically calculate team payroll from the calendar and reports, with a clear breakdown and exports for production, accounting and each worker individually.

cta.title: Organize your work with more clarity
cta.text: SetLux is in active development and we’re looking for professionals to test it.

footer.description: The complete solution for managing the lighting department in audiovisual productions.
footer.bottom2: Designed specifically for lighting department professionals.
